prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily along a narrow dirt path flanked by dense trees, their trunks rising vertically into the dimly lit night sky. The camera advances forward, capturing the subtle undulations of the terrain as it gently slopes upward. The surrounding foliage is thick, with leaves and branches occasionally brushing against the edges of the frame, creating a sense of immersion within the forest. As the path continues, the camera angle shifts slightly to reveal an opening ahead where the trees thin out, exposing a vast expanse of water under a cloudy, foggy sky. The horizon is barely visible through the mist, adding a layer of mystery to the scene. The camera then pans back to the path, continuing its forward motion as the terrain becomes more uneven, with exposed roots and patches of grass becoming more prominent. The lighting remains consistently low, casting deep shadows that enhance the textures of the ground and the surrounding vegetation. The entire sequence maintains a steady pace, with no sudden movements or changes, offering a continuous and immersive experience of a solitary walk through the natural landscape of Shengshan Island at night.
